entry.title: Ansible Galaxy
entry.why: Find maintained Ansible collections for an automation need.
entry.status: External catalog; Ansible collections are not agent skills. Check publisher and version.

briefing.purpose: Find maintained Ansible collections for an automation need.
briefing.inputs: Required capability, Ansible version and publisher requirements.
